data.name: Primary Efficacy Objective
data.text: To demonstrate the superiority of retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg versus placebo in glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Additional Glycemic Control
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in additional measures of glycemic control

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Weight Management
data.text: To demonstrate that retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and/or 12 mg are superior to placebo in weight management

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Combined Glycemic Control and Weight Management

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (9 mg and 12 mg)

data.name: Key Secondary Objective - Blood Pressure (9 mg and 12 mg)

data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on additional measures of weight management

data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg, 9 mg, and 12 mg with placebo on additional measures of blood pressure

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Systolic Blood Pressure (4 mg)
data.text: To compare retatrutide 4 mg with placebo on additional measures of blood pressure

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (All Doses)

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Lipid Parameters (4 mg)

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Biomarker of Inflammation

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - Patient-Reported Outcomes

data.name: Additional Secondary Objective - PK/PD Characterization

data.name: Primary Efficacy Estimand - Treatment Regimen Estimand (HbA1c Change from Baseline) - Retatrutide 4 mg vs Placebo
data.populationSummary: Adult participants with Type 2 Diabetes and inadequate glycemic control with diet and exercise alone, naive to insulin therapy (except gestational diabetes or ≤14 days acute use), and not treated with any oral or injectable antihyperglycemic medications within 90 days prior to study entry, with HbA1c ≥7.0% to ≤9.5% (Intent-to-Treat (ITT) Population) Summary measure: Difference in least squares means of change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40.

intercurrentEvents.name: Treatment discontinuation
intercurrentEvents.text: Permanent discontinuation of study intervention before Week 40. Under the treatment regimen estimand, treatment adherence is part of the treatment condition; all data regardless of discontinuation are included.

intercurrentEvents.name: Initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medications
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant initiates additional antihyperglycemic medications (rescue therapy) during the study. Under the treatment regimen estimand, this is considered part of the treatment condition; all data are used regardless of initiation.

intercurrentEvents.name: Dose modification or interruption
intercurrentEvents.text: Participant undergoes dose modification or temporary interruption of study intervention. Considered part of the treatment condition and not an intercurrent event.

data.treatment: Retatrutide 4 mg once weekly vs Placebo once weekly for 40 weeks. Treatment adherence and initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medications are considered part of the treatment condition.
data.variableOfInterest: Change from baseline in HbA1c (%) at Week 40
data.summaryMeasure: Difference in least squares means of change from baseline in HbA1c at Week 40
